**[Open OpenStock](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app)** · [Changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog) · [Self-host it](#self-hosting) · [Sponsor](#sponsors) · [Discord](https://discord.gg/JkJ8kfxgxB)
# OpenStock **Markets, minus the paywall.** OpenStock is a free, open-source alternative to expensive market platforms: track prices, watch the whole market and dig into company insights. Use it at [openstock-ods.vercel.app](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app), or run your own copy with every feature. > ❤️ **13,000+ people use OpenStock for free.** Help keep it that way: [sponsor from $5 a month](https://github.com/sponsors/ravixalgorithm/sponsorships?frequency=recurring&amount=5), or read [how OpenStock is funded](#sponsors). > [!NOTE] > OpenStock is community-built and not a brokerage. Market data may be delayed depending on the provider and your setup. Nothing here is financial advice. ## 📋 Table of Contents 1. 🔋 [Features](#features) 2. ⏱️ [How fresh is the data](#data-freshness) 3. ⚙️ [Tech stack](#tech-stack) 4. 🤸 [Quick start](#quick-start) 5. 🔐 [Environment variables](#environment-variables) 6. 🐳 [Self-hosting](#self-hosting): Docker, prebuilt image, one-click deploys, Vercel 7. 🧱 [Project structure](#project-structure) 8. 📡 [How it works](#data--integrations) 9. 🌍 [Market support](#market-support) 10. 🧪 [Scripts and tests](#scripts--tooling) 11. 🤝 [Contributing](#contributing) 12. 🏆 [Contributors](#contributors) 13. 🛡️ [Security](#security) 14. 📜 [License](#license) 15. 🌱 [Open Dev Society manifesto](#manifesto) 16. 🙏 [Acknowledgements](#acknowledgements) 17. ❤️ [Sponsor OpenStock](#sponsors) ## 🔋 Features **Markets** - A dashboard for seven markets: US, India, Germany, Canada, Australia, Crypto and Forex, with an index pulse, a sector heatmap, market leaders and top stories. - Search every exchange Finnhub covers with **⌘K**, and keep stocks open as browser-style tabs. **Stock pages** - TradingView candles with drawing tools (trend lines, Fibonacci, shapes, text) and fullscreen. - Pick indicators once (SMA, EMA, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, RSI, MACD, Stochastic, ATR) and they stay on every chart. - Financials, technicals and the company profile. - Sentiment from Reddit, X, news and Polymarket (with an Adanos key). **Watchlist and alerts** - A watchlist of up to 50 stocks, saved to your account. - Price alerts above or below a target, checked every 5 minutes and emailed to you (in realtime mode). - A weekly, AI-written news digest by email every Monday. **Accounts** - Email and password, plus Google and GitHub sign-in when configured; password reset and a profile page. - Rate-limited sign-in, sign-up and password reset; resetting your password signs out your other devices. **Community** - A [changelog](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/changelog) that credits everyone who contributed, a [Wall of love](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app/love), and an update banner in the app. ## ⏱️ How fresh is the data Charts always stream live from TradingView. Quotes, watchlist prices and alerts come from Finnhub: | | Quotes | Price alerts | Cost | |---|---|---|---| | **Community**: [openstock-ods.vercel.app](https://openstock-ods.vercel.app) | Every hour, shared by everyone | No | Free | | **OpenStock Cloud** (coming soon) | Every 15 seconds | By email | $5 a month | | **Self-hosted** | Every hour, or every 15 seconds with `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE=realtime` and your own Finnhub keys | By email, in realtime mode | Free | ## ⚙️ Tech stack | | | |---|---| | App | Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui and Radix | | Accounts and data | Better Auth, MongoDB with Mongoose | | Market data | Finnhub, TradingView widgets, Adanos (sentiment) | | Background jobs | Inngest | | Email | Nodemailer (Gmail), Kit for the newsletter | | AI | Gemini, MiniMax or Siray | | Hosting | Vercel; a Docker image on GitHub Container Registry for self-hosting | ## 🤸 Quick start You need Node.js 22 LTS, a MongoDB database (a free Atlas cluster, or the [Docker setup](#docker-setup)) and a free [Finnhub](https://finnhub.io) key. ```bash git clone https://github.com/Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock.git cd OpenStock npm ci cp .env.example .env # fill in MONGODB_URI, BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and FINNHUB_API_KEY node scripts/check-env.mjs # checks your .env npm run test:db # checks the MongoDB connection npm run dev # http://localhost:3000 ``` Welcome emails, price alerts and the weekly digest run as [Inngest](https://www.inngest.com) jobs. Locally, start Inngest's dev server alongside the app: `npx inngest-cli@latest dev`. For production: `npm run build && npm start`. ## 🔐 Environment variables Every variable is listed with comments in [`.env.example`](.env.example). The ones that matter: | Variable | Needed | What it's for | |---|---|---| | `MONGODB_URI` | Yes | Your MongoDB database | | `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` | Yes | Signs sessions. Generate it with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Auth refuses to run in production without it | | `BETTER_AUTH_URL` | Yes | The app's public URL, used for auth callbacks and links in emails | | `FINNHUB_API_KEY` | Yes | Market data. Or put several free keys, comma-separated, in `FINNHUB_API_KEYS`: they're rotated, and each adds 60 requests a minute | | `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE` | No | `cached` (hourly, the default) or `realtime` (every 15 seconds, with price alerts). Fixed when the app is built: rebuild after changing it | | `INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY`, `INNGEST_EVENT_KEY` | In production | Background jobs: welcome emails, price alerts and the weekly digest | | `NODEMAILER_EMAIL`, `NODEMAILER_PASSWORD` | No | Sending email through Gmail, with an app password. Without them, emails are skipped | | `GEMINI_API_KEY` (or MiniMax or Siray) | No | AI-written welcome emails and the news digest | | `ADANOS_API_KEY` | No | The sentiment card on stock pages | | `KIT_API_KEY`, `KIT_API_SECRET`, `KIT_WELCOME_FORM_ID` | No | The weekly digest newsletter in Kit | | `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID` / `_SECRET`, `GITHUB_CLIENT_ID` / `_SECRET` | No | Social sign-in. Callbacks: `/api/auth/callback/google` and `/github` | `NEXT_PUBLIC_FINNHUB_API_KEY` still works as a name for the Finnhub key. No key is ever sent to the browser. ## 🐳 Self-hosting ### Docker Compose Runs OpenStock and MongoDB together. MongoDB is only reachable inside the Docker network; it isn't published on your machine. 1. Fill in `.env` (see above). For the bundled database, choose a password and use it in both places. Letters and digits are simplest; `@ : / ? #` must be percent-encoded in the URI. ```env MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD=change-me MONGODB_URI=mongodb://root:change-me@mongodb:27017/openstock?authSource=admin ``` 2. Start it: `docker compose up -d --build` 3. Open http://localhost:3000 The image build needs no secrets: every variable is read when the container starts, except `NEXT_PUBLIC_OPENSTOCK_DATA_MODE`, which Compose passes to the build from `.env`. # Why Twenty Twenty gives technical teams the building blocks for a custom CRM that meets complex business needs and quickly adapts as the business evolves. Twenty is the CRM you build, ship, and version like the rest of your stack. Learn more about why we built Twenty
# Installation ### Cloud The fastest way to get started. Sign up at [twenty.com](https://twenty.com) and spin up a workspace in under a minute, with no infrastructure to manage and always up to date. ### Build an app Scaffold a new app with the Twenty CLI: ```bash npx create-twenty-app my-app ``` Define objects, fields, and views as code: ```ts import { defineObject, FieldType } from 'twenty-sdk/define'; export default defineObject({ nameSingular: 'deal', namePlural: 'deals', labelSingular: 'Deal', labelPlural: 'Deals', fields: [ { name: 'name', label: 'Name', type: FieldType.TEXT }, { name: 'amount', label: 'Amount', type: FieldType.CURRENCY }, { name: 'closeDate', label: 'Close Date', type: FieldType.DATE_TIME }, ], }); ``` Then ship it to your workspace: ```bash npx twenty app:publish --private ``` See the [app development guide](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/extend/apps/getting-started) for objects, views, agents, and logic functions. Building with a coding agent? Install the official [Twenty app skills](./packages/twenty-agent-skills), which work in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, and any other harness supported by the `skills` CLI: ```bash npx skills add https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/tree/agent-skills --list ``` The `agent-skills` branch is created by the first successful publish from `main`. Until then, use the [local build instructions](./packages/twenty-agent-skills#local-development). [`SKILLS.md`](./SKILLS.md) explains the other skill families in this repository and who they are for. ### Self-hosting Run Twenty on your own infrastructure with [Docker Compose](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/self-host/capabilities/docker-compose), or contribute locally via the [local setup guide](https://docs.twenty.com/developers/contribute/capabilities/local-setup).
